en: Welcome aboard the S.S. Aqua! We're bound for Vermilion City in Kanto. Shall we cast off?
Anchors aweigh! Make yourself at home. We'll be there before you know it.
The S.S. Aqua sped east across the sea, skimming the waves...
We've docked at Vermilion City, Kanto! Mind your step on the gangway.
Welcome aboard the S.S. Aqua! We're bound for Olivine City in Johto. Shall we cast off?
Anchors aweigh! Make yourself at home. We'll be there before you know it.
The S.S. Aqua sped west across the sea, skimming the waves...
We've docked at Olivine City, Johto! Mind your step on the gangway.
No rush. The gangway's behind you, if you'd rather stay ashore a while longer.
